run_split_json_cli: run split_json.py to split loose JSON corpora into train dev and test splits
run_split_json_custom_percent: run split_json.py with custom test_percent to control val and test dataset sizes
review_get_lines: review the get_lines function that reads and strips lines from a JSON file
review_get_splits: review the get_splits function that shuffles and partitions lines into train dev and test
review_write_files: review the write_files function that writes split data and mapping files to disk
